subject: geography
title: Case Study: BedZED and Curitiba
welcome_lead: Visit two famous sustainable places: BedZED in London and Curitiba in Brazil. See sustainable living in action!
meta_desc: KS3 Geography case studies on BedZED and Curitiba sustainable urban projects.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now use real-world sustainable case studies.

concepts.def: Beddington Zero Energy Development in London.
Brazilian city famous for sustainable transport.
Bus Rapid Transit, fast bus system on its own lanes.
Device that turns sunlight into electricity.
Material that keeps heat inside a building.
Homes designed to use little energy.

walkthroughs.body_html: BedZED opened in 2002 in south London. Homes use solar panels, thick insulation, and harvested rainwater. Residents use roughly half the energy of typical UK homes.
Curitiba pioneered BRT (Bus Rapid Transit) in 1974. Fast buses run in dedicated lanes — cheaper than a metro. Over 70% of commuters use public transport.
Sustainable cities need smart design, good public transport, energy efficiency and green spaces. Both case studies prove it works in practice.
